title: High Throughput RNA Extraction and PCR Inhibitor Removal for Wastewater Surveillance
author: Aaron Topol
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2mkqc4w
materials: Check that the Viral RNA Buffers are connected to the Chemagic tubing. If not, perform a normal cleaning procedure, switch to Viral RNA Buffers and prime the system.
Discard Elution Plate with prep solution.

steps.title: Prepare Proteinase K solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve lyophilized Proteinase K in 11 mL nuclease‑free water and resuspend Poly A according to the manufacturer’s directions.

steps.title: Label tubes and plates
steps.instruction: Label one 50 mL conical tube as “Lysis buffer” and label a deep‑well plate as “Sample Plate”.

steps.title: Prime Chemagic if idle
steps.instruction: If the Chemagic 360 has not been used within the previous 24 hours, run the protocol “Check Manifolds All.che” to prime the buffer manifolds.

steps.title: Prepare Magbead and Elution plates
steps.instruction: Generate Elution plates with 60 µL Elution Buffer per well and Magbead plates with 150 µL magnetic beads per well (using a liquid handler such as the Agilent Bravo). If condensation forms on the seal of a prepared Elution plate, briefly spin the plate to collect the buffer at the bottom. Then, with the plate sealed, resuspend the magnetic beads by shaking in a BioShake XP at 1350 rpm, °C, for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Add samples and controls to Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Using a wide‑orifice 1000 µL pipette tip, transfer 300 µL of homogenized wastewater sample to each well of the Sample Plate, ensuring a full 300 µL is aspirated and no clumps are present. Add 300 µL of DNA/RNA Shield stock solution containing BCoV spike‑in to one well as a positive extraction control. Add 300 µL of water to the designated wells for negative extraction controls, then add 10 µL of gRNA SARS‑CoV‑2 control (50 cp/µL) and 4 µL Poly A to the appropriate wells. Water serves as the negative extraction control in row 12; row 11 contains water but those wells are not used downstream.

steps.title: Add Lysis buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Mix the Lysis buffer according to the volumes specified for the Chemagic Viral DNA/RNA 300 Kit H96 (Perkin Elmer Catalog #CMG‑1033‑S). Add 310 µL of this Lysis buffer to each well of the Sample Plate. Note: Proteinase K activity declines after >00:10:00 in Lysis buffer; therefore complete mixing within 10 minutes.

steps.title: Configure Chemagic deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the Chemagic 360 deck as follows: Position 1 – rack with disposable tips; Position 2 – Magbead plate (low‑well) prefilled with 150 µL magnetic beads; Position 3 – Sample Plate; Position 4 – empty deep‑well plate; Position 5 – empty deep‑well plate; Position 6 – empty deep‑well plate; Position 7 – Elution plate (deep‑well) containing 60 µL Elution Buffer; Position 8 – empty Chemagic 360 instrument (Perkin Elmer, 2024‑0020).

steps.title: Run Chemagic extraction
steps.instruction: Select the protocol “chemagic Viral300 360 H96 drying prefilling VD141210.che”, ensure all wells are selected, and start the run.

steps.title: Post‑extraction handling and waste
steps.instruction: When the run finishes, either proceed immediately to PCR inhibitor removal or seal the Elution plate and store on ice. Dispose of the empty tip rack (Pos 1), empty Magbead plate (Pos 2) and the deep‑well plate with tips (Pos 6) in a red biohazard waste bin. Wrap the deep‑well plates in Positions 3, 4, 5 in a blue absorbent pad, seal with lab tape, and discard as chemical waste.

steps.title: Prepare Silicon‑A™‑HRC plate
steps.instruction: Retrieve the Silicon‑A™‑HRC Plate and accompanying Elution Plate from the Zymo OneStep PCR Inhibitor Removal Kit (automation possible with the Agilent Bravo). Mount the Silicon‑A™‑HRC Plate onto an Elution Plate, add 150 µL Prep Solution to each well by piercing the foil cover with the pipette tip, incubate for 00:05:00, then centrifuge at exactly 3500 × g, °C, for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Transfer RNA extracts to inhibitor removal plate
steps.instruction: While preparing the Silicon‑A™‑HRC Plate, place the Chemagic Elution Plate on an ALPAQUA Magnum EX Universal Magnet Plate for 2 minutes to pull down residual magnetic beads. Then mount the pre‑treated Silicon‑A™‑HRC Plate with the RNA extracts onto a new Elution Plate and transfer the full volume of extracted RNA from the Chemagic Elution Plate onto the Silicon‑A™‑HRC Plate.

steps.title: Final cleanup and storage
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at exactly 3500 × g, °C, for 00:03:00, immediately seal the Elution Plate and store on ice until ddPCR analysis.
